name: AI Deep Dive — LBRT — 2026-05-02
rationale: Liberty Energy (LBRT) has seen its stock price surge 181% over the past year despite a significant deterioration in core fundamentals. Free cash flow has collapsed from $411M to just $14M, and net margins have compressed to a razor-thin 3.7%. At a $5.3B market cap and trading at a steep 92x forward earnings, the market is pricing in a massive margin recovery that contradicts its low Piotroski F-Score (3). Weighted fair value of $16.54 suggests the stock is severely overvalued and due for a major correction.

aiThesis.rationale: LBRT presents a dangerous divergence between stock price momentum and underlying business health. While the top line sits at a respectable $4B, operational efficiency is plunging. The Piotroski F-Score of 3 highlights weak cash flow generation and deteriorating margins (gross margins fell from 20% to 8% in two years). At 92x forward P/E, the market is treating this cyclical oilfield services company like a high-growth tech stock. The base case ($16.54 PV) models a return to historical averages (5% growth, 4% margins), implying a dramatic 50% downside from current levels.
